info.title: vstupenky.online integrations API
info.description: Delegated personal OAuth, code + PKCE S256, explicit resource and consent. Not an autonomous organization identity. Read-only POSTs may be repeated; keyset pages are not a snapshot. Decimal money remains a string. Never generate a new commandId after a timeout. Refresh once per connection; atomically persist the rotated token. Reuse, lost refresh responses and grant expiry require reconnect. Consent defaults to 7 days; 30/90/365 days require explicit client policy. Consumed refresh proofs use capped encrypted buckets, never eviction of live evidence. Capacity exhaustion rejects new grants or exchanges. A 30-day idle limit never extends consent. Access tokens live at most 300 seconds. OAuth 2.1 and Idempotency-Key are drafts; no FAPI compliance claim. API data uses no-store. Runtime cross-field refinements remain mandatory.

x-client-proof-policy: A registered DPoP-only client must also supply a bound DPoP token and fresh DPoP proof. OAuth alone is never sufficient for that client.

post.description:
Copy one explicitly consented source to an explicitly consented organizer with occasion creation enabled. Uses the canonical SQL copy receipt and the same deterministic resumable image Worker job as Flutter. A pending media state still refers to exactly one committed occasion. Preserve commandId and all inputs on uncertainty.

Preserve the original command identity, payload, preview confirmation and expected aggregate version after an uncertain response. Replay uses the same SQL owner and current rights as MCP; it never implies a second business effect.

dpop.name: DPoP
dpop.description: A per-request signed RFC 9449 proof, not an API key. OAuth and this proof are both required. The OAuth access token uses Authorization: DPoP.

oauth.description: DPoP-bound opaque token in Authorization: DPoP. OAuth alone is insufficient; the signed DPoP header is also mandatory.
